dinkum-3.meaning: "You can work from home, per Agency policy" is somewhat firmer than offering opportunities, although the eligibility thresholds, documents, education alternatives and dates are preserved.
dinkum-3.sense: "Spotting and nutting out production problems" retains identification and analysis, and "get ticked off" correctly means completed here.
dinkum-3.authenticity: "Have a squiz", "Know your way around" and "new starters" are natural Australian phrasing in context.
dinkum-3.register: "Get your head around", "spot on" and "nutting out" give the job notice the moderate vernacular requested without gratuitous swearing.
dinkum-3.tone: "you'll get the chance to learn to do all of it" preserves encouragement, while "You'll need to pass a background check" keeps requirements firm.
dinkum-3.flow: "so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on" has a broken parallel construction, although most of the notice is easy to follow.
dinkum-3.variety: "no worries", "Get your head around", "squiz", "nutting out" and "Getting information across" provide a varied conversational vocabulary.
dinkum-3.essence: "COMBINATION OF EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE" and "AND" retain the eligibility structure, while the sequence of duties, conditions and benefits remains intact.

current.meaning: "Only graduate study beyond the first year (18 semester hours) qualifies" and "telework opportunities under Agency policy" preserve both technical eligibility and the conditional benefit; the full requirements survive.
current.sense: "with legal effect" correctly renders legally effective publication, and "on a pro rata basis" retains how part-time experience is counted.
current.authenticity: "Have a look" and "new starters" are locally natural without any forced accent or bolted-on slogan.
current.register: "Understand and properly address customer needs" and "A one year probationary period may be required" remain close to formal source prose; the moderate vernacular is largely absent.
current.tone: "with training to help you grow in the position" retains the encouraging opportunity, and the eligibility language remains firm and informative.
current.flow: "so they're published accurately, on time and with legal effect" neatly resolves the original's dense wording and the conditions read clearly.
current.variety: "Have a look", "coming up with solutions" and "new starters" vary the limited colloquial phrasing without noticeable repetition.
current.essence: "You must meet these requirements by this announcement's closing date" and the maintained OR/AND structure keep the same practical recruitment notice.

pre-fix-yarn.meaning: "There's the chance to work from home, per Agency policy" retains the opportunity qualification, and the exact grade, experience, educational and identity requirements remain.
pre-fix-yarn.sense: "all the program goals get ticked off" correctly conveys achievement and "sort it out properly" fits addressing customer needs.
pre-fix-yarn.authenticity: "Have a squiz", "Know your way around" and "coming up with fixes" sound like ordinary Australian speech rather than caricature.
pre-fix-yarn.register: "spot on", "get ticked off", "Have a squiz" and "Hit "Print Preview"" sustain a moderate vernacular frame without overdoing it.
pre-fix-yarn.tone: "you'll get training to help you grow into the role" retains encouragement and "You've got to meet these requirements" keeps the notice's firm practical intent.
pre-fix-yarn.flow: "get published legally effective" is grammatically awkward, and "written documents written by other people" retains unnecessary repetition; the rest remains readable.
pre-fix-yarn.variety: "Know your way around", "Have a squiz", "Hit" and "help the program goals along" vary the oral wording rather than leaning on one tag.
pre-fix-yarn.essence: "Specialised Experience: For the GS-09" and all education alternatives preserve the job notice's distinctive layered eligibility structure and detailed official conditions.

dinkum-3.quote: You can work from home, per Agency policy.
dinkum-3.original: We offer opportunities for telework, per Agency policy.
dinkum-3.why: Even with the policy qualification, can work from home sounds more assured than an opportunity for telework.

dinkum-3.quote: so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on.
dinkum-3.original: to ensure legally effective, timely, and accurate publication of them.
dinkum-3.why: Legally effective does not fit grammatically after get published; the mixed modifiers make this duty clunky aloud.

current.quote: Understand and properly address customer needs across every part of the Federal Register publication process
current.original: Understand and appropriately address customer needs associated with all aspects of the Federal Register publication process
current.why: The largely unchanged formal register throughout the duties and conditions falls well below the requested moderate vernacular.

pre-fix-yarn.quote: so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on.
pre-fix-yarn.original: to ensure legally effective, timely, and accurate publication of them.
pre-fix-yarn.why: The adjective legally effective does not join grammatically to get published, making a key duty awkward.

pre-fix-yarn.quote: written documents written by other people
pre-fix-yarn.why: This inherited repetition remains cumbersome in an otherwise conversational retelling.

summaries.dinkum-3: A natural, moderately Aussie job notice that retains the detailed requirements, with one clunky duty and a slightly stronger benefit claim.
summaries.current: The cleanest and most precise prose, but substantially under-retold for level 3.
summaries.pre-fix-yarn: The best overall balance of faithful qualifications and moderate voice, though several source-shaped constructions still impede flow.
